name: FindingDogStory F02 cinematic dock retry from GameDraft originals

params.prompt: Original cinematic concept frame of the confirmed Wujin dock chest inspection, using ONLY original GameDraft project images. The location is the gray stone riverside quay, timber wharf, dark river and continuous old tile-roofed warehouses in the supplied GameDraft dock background. The cargo chest has the exact small leather-and-wood design of the supplied GameDraft chest sprite. The only revealed objects are the supplied round geomantic compass, four torn mountain map pieces and stitched old book. Zero people. All objects natural size: chest around knee high, 40-50 cm tall, occupies less than 18 percent of frame height. No magical stone. No new structure, hill, temple or mountain vista. No UI, no text. Muted hand-painted folk-horror palette. Camera at standing human eye height on the dock, looking laterally ACROSS the quay. Strong horizontal horizon and upright vertical building facades, not an aerial view. Chest open on nearby wharf planks, its contents visible from oblique angle; camera is several meters from it, not a macro shot. Deep cinematic 16:9 framing, dock architecture fills two thirds of composition.
params.negative_prompt: high angle, bird eye, isometric, overhead, top down, huge chest, giant map, product poster, invented scene, extra building, people, person, giant person, fantasy gem, text
